page.note: Already Ukrainian, so the ladder must stand down. activeLanguage ABSTAINS by design: every row is a non-anchor <li>, so the inactive-switcher signal fires on all 42 at once and singles none out, and the site marks its current entry with aria-selected / data-selected — neither of which is an active-entry marker (aria-CURRENT is). htmlLang carries the page instead. Pinning the abstention keeps a future active-marker change visible.
